outcome_summary: Replaced the MCP GUI's inline add-repository form and full-page detail editor with a single shared modal dialog (`renderRepoModal()`), backed by a new `POST /api/repos/:repoId/move` endpoint and enriched `handleGetRepo()` that returns `store_id` for pre-selection in multi-store mode. All 7 work packages completed across 4 pipeline stages (28 stage passes total), with 4031/4031 tests passing and 13 new behavioral tests added. Two high-priority test regressions were identified post-facto in `router-utils.test.ts` and `project-list.test.ts` — stale assertions for the removed detail route — and are flagged for the next cycle.
project_summary: Replace the inline add-repository form and full-page repository detail editor in the MCP GUI with a single shared modal dialog. In multi-store mode, the modal includes a store dropdown that enables moving a repository between stores as part of the save flow, backed by a new POST /api/repos/:repoId/move endpoint.
